draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Tall corner with long limbs and sticky hands.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.72, the 5th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 1st of 37 at CB. He went 4th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Richard Sherman. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 4 passes defended in 2021, 25th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Indianapolis Colts. 59 career games and 59 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 14 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: completion % allowed 48.9% (94th percentile), passes defended 9 (76th percentile). Played 11 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 47.2% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
